verdict.rationale: Vast.ai publishes an official REST API reference section (api-reference/introduction) and serves a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.vast.ai/api/openapi.json, which is the usual basis for an interactive reference. However, no evidence shows an in-browser 'try it' playground or runnable request examples on the API reference pages; the copyable examples in the pack are CLI/SDK snippets, not interactive API calls. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer/playground, runnable request examples on the API reference pages, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference's interactivity
